historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2026 management guidance (mid-single-digit revenue growth, raised July 2026), not a historical CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (+10.9%/+11.3%) diverges >30% from revenue (-0.9%/-6.0%) and EPS (-25.0%/-18.7%) CAGRs over both windows. This is a structural-discontinuity company (TECFIDERA patent-cliff collapse, then a debt-funded acquisition), not a steady compounder -- equity grew because buybacks stopped and earnings retained even as the top line shrank; none of the backward CAGRs is used as the forward driver (see inputs.notes).

scenario_narratives.base: Growth Portfolio (LEQEMBI, SKYCLARYS, EMPAVELI/SYFOVRE) keeps growing faster than legacy MS/biosimilars decline, delivering the guided mid-single-digit consolidated growth; margin recovers from the FY2026 Apellis-integration trough toward a mature ~32% as deal costs fade; pipeline readouts land at a normal biotech hit rate.
scenario_narratives.bull: LEQEMBI IQLIK and the Apellis complement franchise both scale faster than expected, several Phase 3 readouts succeed, and integration costs fade ahead of schedule -- margin matures near 37% on a faster-growing revenue base.
scenario_narratives.bear: Legacy erosion outruns the Growth Portfolio, KISUNLA takes the lion's share of Alzheimer's, every near-term pipeline readout disappoints, and Apellis integration drags -- revenue stagnates/shrinks and margin never escapes the high-teens trough.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Biogen is valued as a mid-cycle owner-FCF DCF: FY2026 reported financials are a genuine trough (Apellis acquisition integration/IPR&D charges, purchase-accounting intangible amortization, and legacy-MS patent-cliff erosion still running), not a representative steady state, so margins are built up from components to a normalized mature level over a 10-year horizon rather than extrapolated from the depressed current year. The balance sheet flipped from net cash to ~$6.8B net debt when the ~$5.6B Apellis deal was funded mostly in cash plus new borrowings in May 2026, so interest income is no longer stripped from FCF. The investment case is a race between a shrinking, capital-light legacy MS/biosimilar base and a faster-growing but partly acquired and partly still-unproven Growth Portfolio (LEQEMBI, SKYCLARYS, EMPAVELI, SYFOVRE) layered with genuinely binary near-term pipeline readouts -- which is why the bear weight is raised above the house default and the terminal multiple is capped well below a typical tech comparable.
key_risks_to_valuation: Five Phase 3 pipeline readouts (litifilimab, felzartamab, dapirolizumab pegol, zorevunersen) over the next four quarters are binary and could each remove a pillar of the growth story
LEQEMBI's commercial ramp continues to trail Eli Lilly's more-conveniently-dosed KISUNLA, capping the addressable share of the Alzheimer's market
Apellis accretion is guided for 2027 but integration risk (retaining key talent, realizing synergies) could push that out, prolonging the current margin trough

Legacy MS franchise (TECFIDERA, VUMERITY, SPINRAZA) faces structurally more convenient/differentiated competitors (Evrysdi, Zolgensma, Kesimpta) and its near-term resilience (SPINRAZA high-dose conversion) may not persist
Elevated leverage post-Apellis (~$8.1B total debt) increases interest-rate and refinancing sensitivity versus Biogen's historically low-leverage profile
Drug-pricing policy (IRA Medicare negotiation exposure) and international HTA/reimbursement negotiations for new launches are an ongoing regulatory overhang

inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 10-K cash flow statement: 'Share-based compensation' $290.8M add-back plus 'Payments related to issuance of stock for share-based compensation arrangements, net' (equity award withholding tax) $10.0M = $300.8M. Cross-checked against H1 2026 10-Q: SBC $161.4M + equity-award tax $49.1M = $210.5M for the half.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-09-25T20:00:01Z regular close (Yahoo Finance chart API); 52-week range 135.39-229.19
inputs.wacc_rationale: CAPM in USD: risk-free 4.2% (10yr UST, Sep-2026), ERP 4.5%, levered beta ~0.85 (large pharma with newly elevated leverage post-Apellis) -> cost of equity 8.0%. Cost of debt 5.0% pre-tax / ~4.0% after-tax at a 20% marginal rate. Capital weights from market cap (~$33.8B at 148.7M diluted shares x $227.60) and total debt ($8,090.3M) post-Apellis: E/V ~81%, D/V ~19%. Blended WACC ~7.25%, rounded to 7.5% to reflect binary Phase 3 pipeline risk not fully captured by a backward-looking beta -- applied once, at the discount rate, not stacked on top of the probability-weighted scenarios (section 7f: risk charged exactly once).
inputs.lease_treatment: Immaterial. Operating lease liabilities of $264.8M (2026-06-30) are ~1.4x FY2025 owner FCF and lease cost is a small fraction of opex; not separately modelled -- lease expense is embedded inside SG&A/COGS and D&A as reported, consistent with how the historical FCF series was built.
inputs.nci_treatment: None. Biogen has no material non-controlling interests; all net income is attributable to Biogen Inc.
inputs.notes:
MODEL: Owner-FCF DCF via SKILL.md routing table -- Biogen is a standard operating biopharma company (no bank/REIT/LIC/holdco characteristics), so the owner-FCF component-build engine applies with the mid-cycle/normalizing-margin treatment from owner-fcf.md section 2: FY2026 financials are a genuine trough, depressed by (a) the ~$5.6B all-cash-plus-CVR Apellis acquisition closed 2026-05-14 (elevated purchase-accounting intangible amortization, integration/restructuring charges, and acquired-IPR&D milestone expense -- H1 2026 EBITDA margin excl. these one-offs was ~25% vs ~18% as reported) and (b) continued TECFIDERA/legacy-MS erosion (down ~53% YoY) only partially offset so far by the Growth Portfolio (LEQEMBI, SKYCLARYS, EMPAVELI/SYFOVRE) which first exceeded legacy-MS revenue in Q2 2026. A flat FY2025/FY2026 margin carried forward would badly understate the business; a component build ramping margin to a normalized mature level over a 10-year horizon is used instead (section 2d: extend the horizon until the margin has matured -- year-9/10 base-case margin is flat at 32% EBITDA / ~22% owner-FCF, confirming the terminal year is mature).

NET CASH -> NET DEBT SWITCH: Biogen held net cash through FY2025 (interest income $125.0M on a cash+marketable-securities pile that exceeded FY2025 owner FCF), but the Apellis acquisition was funded largely in cash plus new borrowings, flipping the balance sheet to net debt of $6,805.3M at 2026-06-30 (cash $1,285.0M vs total debt $8,090.3M: $800.0M current term loan + $7,290.3M notes/term loan). Interest income is therefore NOT stripped from FCF in this build (net cash is no longer material/positive) -- H1 2026 interest income was only $63.2M against $149.9M of interest expense, both already embedded in reported net income/OCF.

HISTORICAL GROWTH DIVERGENCE (>30%, flagged per section on CAGR selection): revenue 3yr CAGR -0.9%, 5yr CAGR -6.0%; EPS 3yr CAGR -25.0%, 5yr CAGR -18.7%; owner-FCF CAGR swings from -14.5% (5yr, dragged by a 2022-2023 IPR&D-charge trough) to +27.2% (3yr, recovering off that trough); shareholders'-equity CAGR +10.9% (3yr) / +11.3% (5yr) -- positive and steady because zero buybacks since FY2023 let retained earnings compound equity even as revenue and EPS declined. None of these backward-looking CAGRs is used as the forward growth driver: the business underwent a structural discontinuity (patent-cliff collapse of the core franchise, then a debt-funded acquisition) that CAGR arithmetic cannot represent. Forward growth is instead anchored to (1) FY2026 guidance of mid-single-digit revenue growth (raised from a prior guided decline) and (2) the Analysis JSON's named growth/risk drivers (LEQEMBI ramp incl. IQLIK at-home dosing, SKYCLARYS international launch, Apellis products, SPINRAZA high-dose conversion vs. legacy MS/biosimilar erosion and five binary Phase 3 pipeline readouts over the next four quarters).

SBC is genuinely low for this sector (~3% of revenue vs 10-15%+ typical for US tech) -- house and street bases are close together; band_position will be a real but narrow spread, not degenerate.

Buybacks: $0 in FY2023, FY2024, H1 2025 and H1 2026 -- the $5.0B 2020 Share Repurchase Program has ~$2.1B remaining authorized but unused; all recent free cash flow has gone to debt paydown and the Apellis acquisition. Share count held flat per the model convention (SBC fully expensed = the charge for grant dilution), but buyback_cash=0 is recorded as a genuine non-repurchase, not merely a modelling convention the company has already funded.

Terminal cap multiple set to 15x (below the 18-20x default) to reflect that mature large-cap pharma trades at lower cash-flow multiples than tech/SaaS comparables, and because the pipeline that would justify a richer multiple is itself binary and already reflected in the scenario spread rather than the terminal multiple.

bear.narrative: Legacy MS and biosimilar erosion (TECFIDERA -53% YoY, biosimilars -16% YoY) outpaces the Growth Portfolio's offset; LEQEMBI continues to underdeliver against a more conveniently-dosed KISUNLA and Eli Lilly captures the larger share of the Alzheimer's market; all five near-term Phase 3 readouts disappoint or fail, removing the pipeline optionality that underpins the 'New Biogen' story; Apellis integration runs long and accretion slips past 2027, keeping margin compressed near the FY2026 trough for years; SPINRAZA's near-term high-dose-conversion offset to Evrysdi/Zolgensma competition proves temporary.

base.narrative: Growth Portfolio (LEQEMBI incl. IQLIK at-home dosing, SKYCLARYS international expansion, EMPAVELI/SYFOVRE from Apellis) continues scaling and offsets legacy MS/biosimilar erosion at a mid-single-digit consolidated pace, in line with raised FY2026 guidance. EBITDA margin recovers from a genuine FY2026 trough (Apellis integration costs, acquired-IPR&D milestone charges, purchase-accounting intangible amortization) toward a mature ~32% as one-off deal costs fade and Apellis becomes EPS-accretive from 2027 as management guides. Pipeline readouts (litifilimab, felzartamab, dapirolizumab, zorevunersen) are a mixed bag -- some succeed, some don't -- consistent with a base rate for late-stage biotech, contributing modestly to the tail growth rather than driving a re-rating.

bull.narrative: LEQEMBI IQLIK materially improves adherence and Alzheimer's uptake accelerates faster than KISUNLA erodes share; SKYCLARYS and the Apellis complement franchise (EMPAVELI, SYFOVRE) both beat expectations in nephrology/ophthalmology; several of the five near-term Phase 3 readouts (litifilimab, felzartamab, dapirolizumab, zorevunersen) succeed, adding real optionality; Apellis accretion arrives on schedule from 2027 and integration costs fade faster than guided, letting margin recover to a best-in-class ~37% mature level.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear weight raised from the 15% house default to 30% because the base case depends on several things happening together in the near term (Apellis accretion arriving on schedule, LEQEMBI IQLIK driving real uptake against a more-convenient competitor, and at least some of five binary Phase 3 readouts over the next four quarters landing well) with legacy-MS erosion a known, currently-running headwind rather than a hypothetical risk. Bull weight trimmed to 25% because it requires most of those same binary events to go right simultaneously, not just the growth thesis broadly working. Base kept as the modal case at 45% given management's own guidance has already been raised on the back of realized H1 2026 results.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fy_end_month_source: December (fallback: no fiscal_year_end and no annual filing)
